name: visual_branch_attribution_2026_09_20
purpose: Decompose Base-history and auxiliary-history adaptation; compare MTE-derived auxiliary features to capacity-matched non-MTE LAOM state-adapter. Existing effects examined: exploratory, not fresh confirmatory evidence.

modes.baseonly: Base history plus decoder; auxiliary history frozen
modes.auxonly: auxiliary history plus decoder; Base history frozen

control: LAOM auxiliary history has same 16-dimensional output and 80784 parameters as each MTE history. Base has 32 outputs; both paths share decoder architecture/initialization, observation normalization, labels and samples. Each family retains its own action-free pretrained latent normalization, fixed across its four modes. LAPO 128-dimensional history excluded from capacity-matched test.
inference: Within-family five branch contrasts per Holm family. MTE-minus-LAOM at four modes yields16 contrasts in one additional Holm family. Paired five upstream seeds after27 evaluation conditions; t95 and exact two-sided sign flip with minimum p .0625. MIF prespecified primary identity, all families/directions retained. No reward-based tuning, seed removal or model/budget substitution.
qualification: 10 real smoke paths,50 frozen/joint600-update decoder/fit reproductions and50 old908601 action/reward replays. Joint history state equality; frozen branches fingerprint unchanged. Full gates before formal runs, all weights frozen before evaluation.
boundary: Only current gradients change. Observation-only pretraining artifacts, RGB/PCA and source data remain immutable. Exactly400 budgeted target actions, no partner labels/simulator queries in grounding. This is supervised downstream adaptation, not frozen-policy main protocol. No claim selective freezing removes information. No new environment or causal proof of MTE construction.
